issues.description: Method getNumberOfStudentsPerTutor(): Return type mismatch. The problem statement UML (Lecture#getNumberOfStudentsPerTutor) declares the method as returning int, while the template scaffolding includes a hint that the return type should be double, and the solution implementation defines the method as public double getNumberOfStudentsPerTutor(). This conflicting information can confuse students about which return type to implement and may cause implementations or tests to fail if they follow the UML instead of the template/solution.
issues.suggestedFix: Make the return type consistent across artifacts. Recommended: Update the UML line in problem_statement.md to declare +getNumberOfStudentsPerTutor(): double to match the template hint and the solution implementation. If an integer result is truly intended, instead change the template comment and the solution method signature to return int and update any dependent code/tests accordingly.
